title: The first car
text: In 1886, Karl Benz built the first practical petrol car. It had three wheels and went about sixteen kilometres an hour.

title: Cars for everyone
text: In 1908, Ford launched the Model T. Later, the assembly line made cars cheap enough for ordinary families.

title: Style era
text: The nineteen fifties brought chrome, big tail fins, and cars that were all about style.

title: Fuel crisis
text: In the nineteen seventies, an oil crisis made people want smaller cars that used less fuel.

title: The first hybrid
text: In 1997, the Toyota Prius arrived in Japan. It was the first mass produced hybrid car.

title: Electric gets fast
text: In 2008, the Tesla Roadster showed the world that electric cars could be fast.

title: Cars with brains
text: Today, cars get software updates, driver assist features, and cameras all around.

title: What is coming?
text: And the future? Self driving cars, maybe even flying taxis. Which car would you drive? Tell me in the comments.
